sections.title: Joystick (Joystick mode)
keys: motor 1, base: follows the stick, centred = rest
motor 2, shoulder: follows the stick, centred = rest
motor 5, wrist roll: follows the stick, centred = rest
motor 4, wrist pitch: 5 degrees a press
motor 6, claw: held = closed, released = open
a held hat direction or button is one press; motors 3 and 4 stay where you stepped them
every motor stays inside its min / max from config.json; invert flips its direction

sections.title: Gamepad (Joystick mode, when no joystick is plugged in)
keys: motor 4, wrist pitch: 5 degrees a press
motor 6, claw: held = closed, released = open
a joystick always wins over a gamepad; plug either in any time

sections.title: Keyboard (every mode except IK; click the window first)
keys: motor 4, wrist pitch: up / down 5 degrees
motor 6, claw: held = closed, released = open
every motor back to the rest pose
holding a key repeats it; in Joystick mode a key moves a stick motor until you move that stick again
